problem: A partial Windows-safe path check blocked classic device names but still accepted CONIN$/CONOUT$, superscript COM/LPT aliases, reserved characters, controls, and device stems padded before extensions.
cause: The validator enumerated familiar examples instead of implementing the complete per-segment Windows reserved-name and reserved-character semantics.
rule: For cross-version Windows-safe refs, implement one explicit segment predicate matching canonical reserved semantics and regression-test the full alias, character, control-byte, ADS, trailing-alias, traversal, and valid-nested matrices.
applies_to: Windows path validation, artifact imports, archive extraction, cross-version Python tooling
